definition: nominal-budget ratio min(1, B / (prompt + generated tokens)) per row: a budget-to-sequence-length ratio, not live occupancy, K/V bytes or an eviction count
ratio_one: ratio 1 = the sequence never exceeded the budget (nothing pruned, by construction); ratio < 1 does not prove a prune (periodic pruning, no per-row prune record), so n_ratio_one is a LOWER bound on never-compressed
